The most important thing about the university are the people – over 17,800 students, around 500 professors, 750 lecturers and 660 staff. We feel committed to our guiding principle: “transforming knowledge into know-how and learners into leaders.”

Quality is always first and foremost. The most important quality of our teaching and research is its close link to practice. The link to practice is guaranteed by our professors due to their strong economic contacts.
